# web.zig source snapshot

Source: https://github.com/tzekid/web.zig
Revision: `4c53178bd6e7843eebe788163e5c4e8ec7d20710` (compatible ecosystem revision).
License: MIT; see `LICENSE`.

Captured tracked source with `git archive`; no Git metadata, caches, build outputs,
or local planning files. Runtime source is unchanged. The sole upstream-file
change is expanding `build.zig.zon` export paths so its tests and consumer build
remain present in a source package. dbui qualifies this snapshot with its own
pinned Zig version; updating the neighboring checkout cannot change this build.
